CHAPTER.VERS:
Bow down thy ear, O LORD, hear me: for I poor and needy.
A Prayer…: or, A Prayer, being a Psalm of David

Preserve my soul; for I holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
holy: or, one whom thou favourest

Be merciful to me, O Lord: for I cry to thee daily.
daily: or, all the day
Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for to thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
For thou, Lord, good, and ready to forgive; and abundant in mercy to all them that call upon thee.
Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
Among the gods none like thee, O Lord; neither like thy works.
All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
For thou great, and doest wondrous things: thou God alone.
Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

For great thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
hell: or, grave

O God, the proud have risen against me, and the assemblies of violent have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
violent: Heb. terrible
But thou, O Lord, a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in mercy and truth.
O turn to me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength to thy servant, and save the son of thy handmaid.
Show me a sign for good; that they who hate me may see , and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast helped me, and comforted me.
